a.lede: Carrier signal still reaches Earth, but science and engineering data have gone AWOL
a.title: Voyager 1 celebrates one light-day with a nice lie-down

b.lede: The spacecraft stores data on an eight-track tape, but it’s managed to stay in contact with scientists for decades. Now, it’s the first human-made object to travel a light-day away from Earth.
b.title: Voyager 1 Beat the Odds and Is Still Working a Light-Day Away From Earth
